source: BNBC 1993 / 2006 Part 6 Sec 2.5: the equivalent static base shear V = Z I C W / R (2.5.6.1), C = 1.25 S / T^(2/3) <= 2.75 (2.5.6.3), C/R at least 0.075, T = Ct hn^(3/4) (2.5.6.5), the site coefficient S of soil types S1-S4 (Table 6.2.24), R of the structural systems (Table 6.2.25), the force Ft = 0.07 T V <= 0.25 V at the top when T > 0.7 s and the rest by wx hx (2.5.7). The other seismic values are BNBC 2020's (the parent pack): the drift and its amplification, the irregularities, the response spectrum rules.

SA.description: S1: rock, or stiff soil less than 61 m deep over rock

SB.description: S1: rock, or stiff soil less than 61 m deep over rock

SC.description: S2: deep cohesionless or stiff clay soils more than 61 m deep

SD.description: S3: soft to medium-stiff clays and sands, 9 m or more

SE.description: S4: soft clays or silts more than 12 m deep

sources.designSpectrum: BNBC 1993 2.5.6.1 V = Z I C W / R; 2.5.6.3 C = 1.25 S / T^(2/3) at most 2.75, C/R at least 0.075. SAEngine form: the normalized spectrum 2.75 to TC and 2.75 (TC/T)^(2/3) after it with TC = (1.25 S / 2.75)^1.5 per soil type, factor 1 (Sa = Z I C / R); the equivalent static method from T = 0 on the plateau, the dynamic analysis rising from 1.0 at T = 0 to the plateau at TB = 0.1 s (SAEngine practice: the code's normalized response spectra are not tabulated here)
sources.siteClasses: BNBC 1993 Table 6.2.24 (S1 1.0, S2 1.2, S3 1.5, S4 2.0) mapped to the default pack's classes SA-SE (SA and SB as S1, SC as S2, SD as S3, SE as S4: SAEngine practice, check the soil type against 2.5.4.3)
sources.periodCoefficients: BNBC 1993 2.5.6.5: T = Ct hn^(3/4), hn in m, Ct 0.083 steel moment frames, 0.073 RC moment frames and eccentrically braced frames, 0.049 the others
sources.systems: BNBC 1993 Table 6.2.25: R of the structural systems (the rows the default pack lists; the rows the 1993 table does not have keep BNBC 2020's R, Ω0 and Cd)
sources.lateralForce: BNBC 1993 2.5.7.2: Ft = 0.07 T V at most 0.25 V when T > 0.7 s, the rest Fx = (V - Ft) wx hx / Σ wi hi
sources.designCategories: SAEngine practice: the detailing of the members by zone (zone 1 ordinary, zone 2 intermediate, zone 3 special; essential facilities one step higher), the reading of BNBC 1993 Part 6 Sec 8 (ductile detailing in zone 3) to check
